import numpy as np
def analyze(k):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
    H,W=I.shape
    vals,cnt=np.unique(I,return_counts=True)
    bg=vals[cnt.argmax()]
    # candidate frame colors: those appearing 4x where positions form rect corners
    res={}
    for v in vals:
        if v==bg: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j]==v]
        if len(pts)!=4: continue
        rs=set(p[0] for p in pts); cs=set(p[1] for p in pts)
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
            r0,r1=sorted(rs); c0,c1=sorted(cs)
            res[int(v)]=(r0,r1,c0,c1,H-r0-r1,W-c0-c1)
    print('pair',k,'frame candidates:',{k2:v for k2,v in res.items()})
    # other markers relative to frame
    for v in [int(x) for x in vals if x!=bg]:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i,j]==v]
        if v in res: 
            r0,r1,c0,c1,_,_=res[v]
            others=[(p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0,p[2]) for p in pts if (p[0],p[1])!=(r0,c0) and (p[0],p[1])!=(r0,c1) and (p[0],p[1])!=(r1,c0) and (p[0],p[1])!=(r1,c1)]
            others=[(i-r0,j-c0,int(I[i,j])) for i,j in [(ii,jj) for ii in range(H) for jj in range(W) if I[ii,jj]==v and not((ii,jj) in [(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)])]]
            print('  color',v,'other markers rel frame:',others)
analyze(1); analyze(2); analyze(5)
